answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks through proof of space, requiring nodes to allocate verifiable storage across a rolling horizon. Nodes maintain active status by answering rapid queries from committed sectors, rendering expired credentials an obsolete relic. This forces an attacker to dedicate physical drive space per identity, even if their operational code is brief as a sonnet. However, it penalizes lightweight edge devices and cannot stop adversaries who lease surplus datacenter capacity.
